podcoupling.help: Computes an electronic coupling between two fragments of a SINGLE, already-converged, ordinary (unconstrained, neutral) ground-state DFT calculation, via Projection Operator Diabatization (POD2, Ghan et al.) -- separately diagonalizing each fragment's own donor/acceptor Fock sub-block (in the original AO basis) and reading the coupling off the resulting off-diagonal block, with the paper's own eqn (10) Lowdin correction applied for the two fragment orbitals' own non-orthogonality. Suited specifically to COVALENTLY-BONDED fragment pairs, where neither CDFT (a self-consistent, constrained calculation on the intact system) nor FODFT (two separately-converged, ISOLATED fragment calculations, which cannot represent a bond crossing the fragment boundary at all) apply cleanly -- for non-bonded fragment pairs, the existing 'coupling' tool (DIPRO) remains the established, directly comparable choice. See Baumeier, Kirkpatrick, Andrienko, PCCP 2010, 12, 11103 for the closely related DIPRO method this eqn (10) correction is drawn from, and arXiv:1512.00200 for a direct comparison of POD/POD2 against FODFT and CDFT.

job_name.help: Input file name without extension, also used for intermediate files

orb_file.help: Input orb file -- a SINGLE, already-converged, ordinary (unconstrained, neutral) ground-state DFT calculation on the intact, covalently-bonded supermolecule

fragment_A.help: Atom indices (0-based) making up fragment A, e.g. '0:5' or '0 1 2 3 4 5' -- same syntax as cdft.indices and diabatization.xml's own fragment indices

fragment_B.help: Atom indices (0-based) making up fragment B -- disjoint from fragment_A, same syntax

levA.help: Number of orbitals to cover for fragment A, counting outward from its own HOMO/LUMO boundary, covering BOTH occupied (hole-transport) and virtual (electron-transport) orbitals together in one calculation -- same convention as DFTcoupling's own levA option exactly. 1 covers just {HOMO, LUMO}; 2 covers {HOMO-1, HOMO, LUMO, LUMO+1}; etc.

levB.help: Same as levA, for fragment B -- same convention as DFTcoupling's own levB option

write_cube_files.help: If true, writes a .cube file for each fragment orbital actually covered by levA/levB (both fragments), useful for visualizing/sanity-checking which orbitals the coupling calculation used

xsteps.help: Gridpoints in x-direction for cube file export -- same option as gencube's own xsteps, only used if write_cube_files is true

ysteps.help: Gridpoints in y-direction for cube file export -- same option as gencube's own ysteps, only used if write_cube_files is true

zsteps.help: Gridpoints in z-direction for cube file export -- same option as gencube's own zsteps, only used if write_cube_files is true

padding.help: How far the cube-file grid should start from the molecule, same option as gencube's own padding, only used if write_cube_files is true
